entries.original: A thread tool given the bare id of a closed thread on another device (`thread_create({ thread })`, `thread_send`, `thread_read`, the control tools) reaches it as `<device>/<thread>` does. When every device is asked at once, a device that answers its own lookup in time could pass the 3.5 s cap and be counted silent, so the call answered `host_unavailable`. Now, when that first round finds no holder, each device that stayed silent is asked again alone, one at a time, with no other lookup of that device service in flight. A retry is made only when the earlier lookups finish in time and the call has enough of its time budget left, so `host_unavailable` can still name a device that was not asked again, as well as one that did not answer on its own. ([#14754](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14754)) ([#14936](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14936))

entries.original: `thread_create` on another device no longer answers `idempotency_uncertain` (`reply_lost`) for a session that device did create. The create is opened under the id its `idempotency_key` derives; when the open's reply is lost (a busy device answering after the call's budget), the session that device lists under that id is answered as the created thread, on the spot or on a retry under the same key, and no second session is opened.
